newsitem.title: CHINA: Floods kill 16 in China's Jiangxi-paper.
newsitem.headline: Floods kill 16 in China's Jiangxi-paper.

text.p: Floods caused by torrential rain in southeastern China's Jiangxi province have killed 16 people in recent days, the pro-Beijing newspaper Ta Kung Pao said on Sunday. The flooding destroyed 26,000 houses, hitting more than 340,000 hectares (850,000 acres) of farmland and affecting 5.59 million people in the province, the newspaper said.
Deluges also forced the suspension of train services from eastern China's Shanghai to Fuzhou and Xiamen in southeastern Fujian province, the report said.
Floods across much of southern and eastern China have killed at least 85 people this month, state media and officials said on Friday.
